heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.help: Sends a “Meshloom is alive” message (instance name, uptime, version) on this channel at the chosen interval, so a power cut or a stopped host shows up as silence. It skips quiet hours, pause and limits. ntfy and Gotify cannot alert on a missing message: use a Home Assistant binary_sensor, or a healthchecks-style ping URL below.
heartbeat.urlKept: Saved: leave empty to keep it
heartbeat.urlHelp: With a URL, Meshloom pings it (healthchecks.io, Uptime Kuma push, etc.) instead of sending a message. The service alerts you when pings stop. The URL is stored encrypted and is never shown again.

warnings.notification_heartbeat_dropped: The heartbeat of a notification channel ({{value}}) was out of range or not supported by its type, and was restored as off.

errors.heartbeat_unsupported: This channel type has no heartbeat.
